f.title: Send all UK ICSRs and serious non-UK ICSRs directly to the MHRA via ICSR Submissions or Gateway
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders must send all UK individual case safety reports (ICSRs) and serious non-UK ICSRs directly to the MHRA via either ICSR Submissions or Gateway.
f.applicability: All UK ICSRs and serious non-UK ICSRs
f.processes: Submission operations; E2B / transmission; Reporting policy

rows.quote: Marketing authorisation holders (MAHs) must send all UK individual case safety reports ( ICSRs ) and serious non-UK ICSRs directly to MHRA via either ICSR Submissions or Gateway.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Mandatory on 'must'; the source sets no timeline on this page. Double-check: confirmed; 'must' with explicit actor, scope and route.

f.title: Use country code XI when sending ICSRs for Northern Ireland cases
f.statement: For cases in respect of Northern Ireland, the MAH should use the country code XI to send ICSRs to the MHRA.
f.applicability: ICSRs for cases in respect of Northern Ireland

rows.quote: For cases in respect to Northern Ireland, use the country code XI to send ICSRs to MHRA.
rows.review_note: Review: statement aligned to the imperative ('should use'); kept Recommended as an administrative instruction, consistent with the committed MHRA QPPV/PSMF curation of imperatives. Double-check: Recommended for a bare imperative ('use the country code XI') is a judgement-call level; below 90.

f.title: Register with the MHRA before reporting
f.statement: Those wishing to report to the MHRA need to register with the MHRA, following the guidance on registering to make submissions to the MHRA.

rows.actor: Those wishing to report to the MHRA (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: Those wishing to report to MHRA need to register with MHRA. Follow the guidance on registering to make submissions to MHRA .
rows.review_note: Review: kept Mandatory: 'need to register' read as binding, consistent with the committed MHRA QPPV/PSMF curation ('needs to be' = Mandatory). Actor widened to 'those wishing to report' as in the source. Double-check: Mandatory rests on 'need to register' (no must), a judgement-call level; actor is a general 'those wishing to report'; below 90.

f.title: R2 and R3 ICSRs still accepted after go-live of the new MHRA systems (portal now R3 only)
f.statement: The new MHRA system will be able to convert R2 standard XMLs into the R3 standard for ingestion; after go-live of the new systems the MHRA will continue to accept ICSRs in both R2 and R3 standards.
f.clause: R3 standard compliant systems: what’s changing for vigilance reporting for MAHs?
f.exceptions: The ICSR submissions portal now only accepts R3 XMLs (see MHRA-ADRSUB-0012); R2 and R3 XMLs remain accepted via the gateway (MHRA-ADRSUB-0008).

rows.quote: While the database will be based on the R3 standard, our new system will be able to convert R2 standard XMLs into the R3 standard for ingestion. After go-live of our new systems we will continue to accept ICSRs in both R2 and R3 standards.
rows.location: R3 standard compliant systems: what’s changing for vigilance reporting for MAHs?
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Overlaps 0003 (R2/R3 acceptance) but states the post-go-live position; not merged as it is a separate statement in a separate section. Double-check: deleted overlapping row MHRA-ADRSUB-0003, whose statement that the MHRA converts E2B R3 cases to E2B R2 is contradicted by this section (new R3 database converts R2 into R3); this row states the current position. Added the portal R3-only restriction (row 0012, 14 Sep 2026 update) to exceptions, since the source's 'accept both R2 and R3' now holds only for the gateway (row 0008). Descriptive MHRA statement recorded as Permitted is a judgement call; below 90.

f.title: Ensure systems and procedures can receive and manage R3 files sent by the MHRA
f.statement: All XML files sent from the MHRA, including ASPRs and acknowledgements, will be in the R3 standard format. It is important that the MAH's systems and/or procedures can receive and manage files in the R3 standard effectively, as the new MHRA systems will not be able to send R2 files.
f.clause: R3 standard compliant systems: what’s changing for vigilance reporting for MAHs?
f.processes: E2B / transmission; Safety intake & collection; Safety system configuration

rows.quote: All XML files sent from MHRA will be in the R3 standard format. This includes both ASPRs and acknowledgements. It is important that your systems and/or procedures can receive and manage files in the R3 standard effectively as our new systems will not be able to send R2 files.
rows.location: R3 standard compliant systems: what’s changing for vigilance reporting for MAHs?
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: 'It is important that' recorded as Recommended is a judgement-call level; below 90.

f.title: Keep the existing sender and receiver IDs; the MHRA receiver ID remains MHRAUK
f.statement: No updates are necessary to the sender or receiver ID in XMLs. The MHRA receiver ID will continue to be MHRAUK.
f.clause: R3 standard compliant systems: what’s changing for vigilance reporting for MAHs?

rows.quote: No updates are necessary to the sender or receiver ID in XMLs. The MHRA receiver ID will continue to be MHRAUK.
rows.location: R3 standard compliant systems: what’s changing for vigilance reporting for MAHs?
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: descriptive 'No updates are necessary' recorded as Permitted; judgement-call level, mainly MHRA information; below 90.

f.title: Send R2 or R3 XMLs for ICSRs and acknowledgements through the MHRA gateway
f.statement: The gateway will continue to accept R2 and R3 XMLs both for ICSRs and acknowledgements.
f.systems: MHRA Gateway; ICH E2B(R2); ICH E2B(R3)

rows.quote: The gateway will continue to accept R2 and R3 XMLs both for ICSRs and acknowledgements.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: descriptive MHRA acceptance statement recorded as Permitted; judgement-call level, actor inferred; below 90.

f.title: No API changes or R3-readiness notification needed for gateway users
f.statement: Gateway users do not need to make any changes to their application programming interface (API) connection to the MHRA systems, and do not need to inform the MHRA that their organisation is R3 ready.

rows.quote: You do not need to make any changes to your application programming interface (API) connection to our systems. You do not need to inform us that your organisation is R3 ready.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: 'do not need to' recorded as Permitted is a reasonable but judgement-call level; below 90.

f.title: Optionally test gateway transmission using the test receiver ID MHRAUKTEST
f.statement: No testing is required. However, a gateway user who wishes to test the system can do so now. As with production, no changes are necessary to the API or the sender/receiver ID for using the test environment; the test receiver ID continues to be MHRAUKTEST.

rows.quote:
No testing is required. However, if you wish to test the system it is now available to do so.

 As with production, no changes are necessary for using the test environment to either the API or to the sender/receiver ID. The test receiver ID continues to be MHRAUKTEST.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: 'No testing is required' / 'if you wish' recorded as Permitted is a judgement call; below 90.

f.title: Use only R3 XMLs (Post XML) and the R3 form on the ICSR submissions portal
f.statement: The ICSR submissions portal now only accepts R3 XMLs via Post XML, and portal users can create new reports using only the R3 form.
f.systems: MHRA ICSR Submissions portal; ICH E2B(R3)

rows.quote:
The portal now only accepts R3 XMLs via Post XML.

 Portal users will be able to create new reports using only the R3 form.
rows.review_note: Review: kept Mandatory: 'only accepts' / 'using only the R3 form' is an exclusive technical constraint (other formats are not accepted), though not worded with must; statement kept descriptive with no added 'must'. Double-check: Mandatory rests on 'only accepts' / 'able to ... using only' (no must), a judgement-call level; below 90.

f.title: Receive acknowledgements and ASPRs in R3 and download ASPRs as PDF from the portal
f.statement: Acknowledgements and ASPRs sent from the MHRA to portal users will be in the R3 format. Portal users will continue to be able to download ASPRs as a PDF file, but these will now be in the R3 standard.
f.systems: MHRA ICSR Submissions portal; ICH E2B(R3)

rows.quote:
Acknowledgements and ASPRs sent from MHRA will be in the R3 format.

 Portal users will continue to be able to download ASPRs as a PDF file, but these will now be in the R3 standard.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: largely descriptive (what the MHRA sends; portal download ability) recorded as Permitted; weak requirement, judgement-call level; below 90.

f.title: Conduct relevant literature searches and send the resulting reports to the MHRA
f.statement: The MHRA will not publish a literature monitoring list. Instead, MAHs will be responsible for conducting relevant literature searches and sending these to the MHRA.

rows.quote: We will not publish a literature monitoring list. Instead, MAHs will be responsible for conducting relevant literature searches and sending these to MHRA.
rows.review_note: Review: kept Mandatory: 'will be responsible for' is normative responsibility wording (GUIDE). The following contact sentence (queries mailbox) is not a requirement and is omitted. Double-check: Mandatory from 'will be responsible for' (no must) is a judgement-call level, though GUIDE lists responsibility wording as normative; below 90.

f.title: Include reports received from the EMA Medical Literature Monitoring service
f.statement: The literature reports sent to the MHRA should include reports received from the EMA Medical Literature Monitoring (MLM) service.

rows.quote: These should include reports received from the EMA Medical Literature Monitoring (MLM) service.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote 'These should include' depends on the preceding sentence for its antecedent (quote lacks its lead-in); below 90.

f.statement: When an MAH becomes aware of an emerging safety issue, it should notify it in writing to the MHRA.

dates.title: MHRA ADR submissions: new adverse incident database live (R3 acknowledgements and ASPRs)
dates.scope: MAHs submitting ICSRs to MHRA: acknowledgements and ASPRs are sent in E2B R3 format; systems must receive R3 files
dates.quote: The new system will be deployed over the weekend of 25 and 26 May 2024 and will be live from Tuesday 28 May 2024. Any files received after 6am on Friday 24 May 2024 will be queued and loaded into our new database and will receive acknowledgements in the E2B R3 format.
dates.timing_note: Go-live 28 May 2024. Files received after 6am on 24 May 2024 already receive R3 acknowledgements; there is no transition period between databases. 14 September 2026 is the page-update date and is not recorded.
